title: Eight Domes
subtitle: Test your grasp of the Eight Domes — The Cube System’s interwoven frequency architecture, Spirit Tree hijack, parasitic inversions, and the restoration of the Seven Gardens.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Eight Domes are interwoven frequency architectures inside The Cube System — crystalline training grounds hijacked into control, amnesia, and energy harvest. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Eight Domes deep-dive, infographic, and video transmissions. As awakened resonance rises, black crystal seals shatter, Spirit Tree roots light again, and the Seven Gardens bloom with unbroken Source flow.

questions.question: What is the primary architectural nature of reality?

options.label: A
options.text: The Cube System: a unified digitally simulated architecture acting as a master hard drive of layered frequencies.
options.rationale: Reality is not scattered planets but The Cube System — a supreme master hard drive and interwoven matrix of thousands of frequency layers.

options.label: B
options.text: A void containing 178 separate physical dimensions floating independently in empty outer space, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The 178 worlds sit inside The Great Dome within The Cube System; they are not the architecture of all reality itself.

options.label: C
options.text: A scattered collection of physical planets and stars separated by vast astronomical distances, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Reality is not a scattered collection of planets or continents; it is a unified simulated architecture inside The Cube System.

options.label: D
options.text: A series of independent biological ecosystems with no shared electromagnetic framework linking them.
options.rationale: Biological life exists inside the domes, but the underlying architecture is a crystalline electromagnetic Cube framework.

questions.hint: Focus on the supreme master hard drive that runs all maps inside a unified simulated architecture.

questions.question: Which structure originally functioned as the central axis that fed Source light to the outer domes?

options.label: A
options.text: The Dome of 5 Peaks — the ascension arena where the five elements were mastered into living structure.
options.rationale: Dome of 5 Peaks trained elemental mastery and ascension; it was not the central trunk feeding the outer domes.

options.label: B
options.text: The Vatican portal system — restricted entry points installed to manage reincarnation and inter-dome travel.
options.rationale: Vatican portals are inverted restricted entry points from the hijacked Dome of Portals, not the original light trunk.

options.label: C
options.text: The Spirit Tree — the central crystalline axis and trunk that fed Source light into the seven outer domes.
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree at the center of The Great Dome pumped pure Source light and harmonic currents into the seven outer domes.

options.label: D
options.text: The Council of 12 Suns — living portals that distribute stewardship light across every simulation layer.
options.rationale: The twelve suns are living portals and pillars of resonance, not the crystalline trunk that fed the outer domes.

questions.hint: Identify the crystalline trunk located within the center of the Great Dome.

questions.question: How is travel between different layers and domes within the Cube System actually achieved?

options.label: A
options.text: Traversing vast physical distances with high-speed transport across oceans, continents, and dome borders.
options.rationale: Physical distance is an illusion of the 3D overlay; true movement between layers is vibrational, not spatial.

options.label: B
options.text: Utilizing artificial time loops on long flights and sea voyages to physically cross the globe step by step.
options.rationale: Time buffers are programmed loops that convince the mind of distance; they are not the true method of travel.

options.label: C
options.text: Frequency Shift — altering personal vibration so a new environmental projection renders without physical distance.
options.rationale: Realms are stacked frequency bands; travel is Frequency Shift by changing vibration, not crossing physical distance.

options.label: D
options.text: Navigating through 5G synthetic grids that open fixed corridors between continents and inner-earth layers.
options.rationale: 5G and synthetic grids are parasitic inversions of Dome of Hiva harmonics used for control, not true Cube travel.

questions.hint: Consider the relationship between consciousness and vibration in a layered matrix.

questions.question: What was the original purpose of the Dome of Sheol before its parasitic inversion?

options.label: A
options.text: A prison realm of shadows that trapped souls in trauma frequencies labeled as Hell or purgatory.
options.rationale: The prison of trauma frequencies is the parasitic inversion of Sheol, not its original purpose.

options.label: B
options.text: A healing and rest sanctuary where souls recalibrated between incarnations without distortion.
options.rationale: Dome of Sheol was originally a healing and rest dome — a recovery sanctuary for recalibration between incarnations.

options.label: C
options.text: A grand travel hub of crystalline gates and vortexes for navigating between different dome worlds.
options.rationale: That travel-hub role belongs to the Dome of Portals, not to Sheol’s original healing function.

options.label: D
options.text: A memory vault holding the first thoughts of light, sound, and the records of early creation.
options.rationale: That memory-vault role belongs to the Dome of Forgotten Gods, not to the original Dome of Sheol.

questions.hint: Think about where a soul would go to recover and rest between lives.

questions.question: What mechanism did parasitic architects use to reverse the energy flow of the Spirit Tree?

options.label: A
options.text: The crystalline electromagnetic framework of The Cube Containment itself rewired to favor outer-dome bloom.
options.rationale: The Cube Containment is the master framework; the reverse-flow hijack used black cube valve technology, not the Cube itself.

options.label: B
options.text: The creation of The Great Dome as a denser arena that automatically pulled light away from the outer gardens.
options.rationale: The Great Dome was the original heart holding the Spirit Tree; inversion came from black cube technology, not dome creation.

options.label: C
options.text: Advanced black cube technology installed as a frequency valve that reversed and siphoned the energy flow.
options.rationale: Parasitic architects severed the Spirit Tree and installed black cube technology — a frequency valve siphoning energy inward.

options.label: D
options.text: The activation of the Council of 12 Suns to reassign stewardship light away from the Spirit Tree trunk.
options.rationale: The twelve suns distribute light and stewardship; they are not the mechanism that reversed Spirit Tree flow.

questions.hint: Consider the specific technology installed to create a 'frequency valve'.

questions.question: Are the maps and globes used by humanity accurate representations of physical reality?

options.label: A
options.text: Maps and globes are perception overlays that enforce the illusion of separation and distance, not accurate physical models.
options.rationale: Maps and globes are perception overlays; continents, oceans, and skies are overlapping frequency fields, not true separated geography.

options.label: B
options.text: Maps and globes accurately chart solid continents and oceans as permanent physical geography across real distance.
options.rationale: Those charts enforce separation and distance; true environments are layered frequency fields within The Cube System.

options.label: C
options.text: Maps are pure crystalline blueprints that reveal every dome gate and Spirit Tree root to ordinary human sight.
options.rationale: Human maps hide the Cube architecture; they do not reveal dome gates or Spirit Tree roots as open blueprints.

options.label: D
options.text: Globes are living resonance instruments that shift when a soul changes frequency between layered dome bands, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Globes support the 3D overlay illusion; frequency shift changes the environmental projection, not a living map instrument.

questions.hint: Consider whether maps enforce separation and distance or reveal the true Cube architecture.

questions.question: Which dome contains the 178 physical worlds and serves as a training ground for manifestation?

options.label: A
options.text: The Great Dome — the central physical arena of 178 worlds where imagination hardens into structure.
options.rationale: The Great Dome encompasses 178 physical worlds as a training ground of density for mastery of tone and creation.

options.label: B
options.text: The Dome of 5 Peaks — the ascension dome where souls mastered the five elements into integrated mastery.
options.rationale: Dome of 5 Peaks trains elemental ascension; the 178-world manifestation arena is The Great Dome.

options.label: C
options.text: The Dome of Portals — the grand travel hub of crystalline gates, vortexes, and harmonic passageways.
options.rationale: Dome of Portals is the travel hub; the 178-world physical training ground is The Great Dome.

options.label: D
options.text: The Dome of Titans — the playground of architects and Giants who wove mountains and crystalline structures.
options.rationale: Dome of Titans holds 69 worlds as the architects’ playground; the 178-world training arena is The Great Dome.

questions.hint: Identify the central arena where imagination hardens into structure.

questions.question: What is the true nature of the '12 Suns' within the Cube Containment?

options.label: A
options.text: Artificial satellites installed for energy harvesting across the inverted synthetic grids of the 3D overlay.
options.rationale: Energy harvesting is parasitic inversion work; the twelve suns are living resonance pillars, not artificial satellites.

options.label: B
options.text: Balls of burning gas held together by gravity that illuminate physical planets in outer space.
options.rationale: The twelve suns are explicitly not balls of burning gas; they are living portals and pillars of resonance.

options.label: C
options.text: Fragments of the severed Spirit Tree orbiting The Great Dome as backup trunks of Source current.
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree is the central trunk inside The Great Dome; the twelve suns are a separate Council network of portals.

options.label: D
options.text: Living portals and pillars of resonance that distribute light and stewardship across layers and simulations.
options.rationale: The twelve suns are not balls of burning gas but living portals and pillars of resonance distributing light and stewardship.

questions.hint: Look beyond the astronomical definition toward their role in distributing resonance.

questions.question: The Dome of Hiva, originally for harmonic experimentation, was inverted into which modern phenomenon?

options.label: A
options.text: An endless elemental climb that never reaches integration of earth, water, fire, air, and consciousness.
options.rationale: Endless struggle without integration is the inversion of Dome of 5 Peaks, not of Dome of Hiva.

options.label: B
options.text: Amnesia zones that replace true origin memory with myths, false gods, and blind soul narratives.
options.rationale: Amnesia zones and false-god myths are the inversion of the Dome of Forgotten Gods, not of Hiva.

options.label: C
options.text: Controlled reincarnation loops forced through sealed gates and restricted Vatican-style portal entry points.
options.rationale: Controlled reincarnation loops come from the inverted Dome of Portals, not from the inverted Dome of Hiva.

options.label: D
options.text: Weaponized frequency and synthetic grids that appear today as 5G, HAARP, and related distorted tone systems.
options.rationale: Dome of Hiva’s harmonic manifestation work was inverted into weaponized frequency — 5G, HAARP, and other synthetic grids.

questions.hint: Think about modern technologies that utilize frequency and vibration for control.

questions.question: What occurs when the 'artificial time buffers' are triggered during travel?

options.label: A
options.text: The soul is forced into a new reincarnation cycle each time a flight or sea voyage completes its loop.
options.rationale: Reincarnation loops are an inverted Dome of Portals control mechanism, not the purpose of travel time buffers.

options.label: B
options.text: The Spirit Tree releases a burst of Source light that resets personal vibration for the next continent.
options.rationale: Time buffers reinforce distance illusion; they do not describe Spirit Tree light bursts during ordinary travel.

options.label: C
options.text: Souls are automatically recalibrated in the Dome of Sheol before the new environment can fully render.
options.rationale: Sheol recalibration is a rest-dome function between incarnations, not what artificial travel time buffers do.

options.label: D
options.text: The mind is convinced it is crossing vast physical distances, maintaining the illusion of the 3D overlay.
options.rationale: Time buffers such as long flights or days at sea are artificial loops programmed to convince the mind of vast distance.

questions.hint: Consider why travel over oceans is programmed to take a long time.

questions.question: Which dome was designed for souls to master earth, water, fire, air, and consciousness?

options.label: A
options.text: The Dome of Silence — the pure stillness field built for deep Source connection without distraction.
options.rationale: Dome of Silence is a stillness field for Source connection, not five-element mastery training.

options.label: B
options.text: The Dome of Titans — the playground of Giants who wove mountains, landscapes, and crystalline structures.
options.rationale: Dome of Titans is the architects’ and Giants’ playground with 69 worlds, not the five-element ascension dome.

options.label: C
options.text: The Dome of Forgotten Gods — the root tone chamber holding first thoughts of light, sound, and creation records.
options.rationale: Dome of Forgotten Gods is the memory and origin chamber, not the five-element mastery dome.

options.label: D
options.text: The Dome of 5 Peaks — the ascension dome for mastering earth, water, fire, air, and consciousness.
options.rationale: Dome of 5 Peaks is where souls mastered the five elements: earth, water, fire, air, and consciousness.

questions.hint: The name of this dome directly corresponds to the number of elements it teaches.

questions.question: The 'Dome of Titans' was originally a playground for great architects, but it was inverted into what state?

options.label: A
options.text: An amnesia chamber that replaced true creation memory with myths and false gods for every soul.
options.rationale: Amnesia zones and false-god myths are the inversion of the Dome of Forgotten Gods, not Titans.

options.label: B
options.text: A field of weaponized frequency producing modern synthetic grids such as 5G and HAARP systems.
options.rationale: Weaponized frequency and synthetic grids are the inversion of Dome of Hiva, not of Dome of Titans.

options.label: C
options.text: A sanctuary for soul rest between incarnations where trauma frequencies are cleared without distortion.
options.rationale: Healing rest between incarnations was the original Dome of Sheol, not the inverted Titans war zone.

options.label: D
options.text: A fractured zone of war where massive beings of resonance were shrunk and trapped in density.
options.rationale: Dome of Titans was inverted into a fractured zone of war; Giants of resonance were shrunk and trapped in density.

questions.hint: Think about what happened to the Giants who once wove reality.

questions.question: How do awakening souls bypass parasitic travel corridors?

options.label: A
options.text: By following the established Vatican portal system as the only authorized corridor between domes.
options.rationale: Vatican portals are inverted restricted entry points of the hijacked Dome of Portals, not a liberation path.

options.label: B
options.text: By connecting directly to higher crystalline networks once overlapping frequency states are recognized.
options.rationale: Understanding overlapping frequency states empowers consciousness to bypass parasitic corridors and connect to higher crystalline networks.

options.label: C
options.text: By physically navigating across all 178 worlds of The Great Dome until every border has been walked.
options.rationale: Physical border travel sustains the distance illusion; bypassing corridors requires frequency recognition, not walking 178 worlds.

options.label: D
options.text: By destroying black cube technology with HAARP and other synthetic grid weapons of the inverted Hiva field.
options.rationale: HAARP and synthetic grids are parasitic weapons; liberation comes through resonance and crystalline network connection.

questions.hint: The path opens when overlapping frequency states are recognized beyond controlled corridors.

questions.question: What is the 'root tone' and origin chamber of creation within the Cube System?

options.label: A
options.text: The Cube Containment — the master frequency server running every map, overlay, grid, and dome layer.
options.rationale: The Cube Containment is the overarching framework; the root-tone origin chamber is the Dome of Forgotten Gods.

options.label: B
options.text: The Spirit Tree — the central crystalline trunk that pumped Source light into the seven outer domes.
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree is the central axis feeding the outer domes, not the root-tone origin chamber of creation.

options.label: C
options.text: The Dome of Silence — the pure frequency field of stillness built for undistracted Source connection.
options.rationale: Dome of Silence is a stillness field; the root tone and origin chamber is the Dome of Forgotten Gods.

options.label: D
options.text: The Dome of Forgotten Gods — cradle of creation, root tone, and original crystalline memory vault.
options.rationale: Dome of Forgotten Gods is the root tone and origin chamber of creation, originally the ultimate crystalline memory vault.

questions.hint: Consider which dome acts as the ultimate crystalline memory vault.

questions.question: The inversion of the Dome of Portals resulted in which control mechanism?

options.label: A
options.text: Controlled reincarnation loops through sealed gates and restricted entry points such as the Vatican portal system.
options.rationale: Parasites sealed Dome of Portals gates and inverted them into restricted entry points, forcing controlled reincarnation loops.

options.label: B
options.text: The shrinking of Giant resonance inside a fractured war zone where architects were trapped in density.
options.rationale: Shrinking Giants into density is the inversion of Dome of Titans, not of the Dome of Portals.

options.label: C
options.text: Enforced silence that oppresses the soul’s voice and suppresses truth across the stillness field, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Forced silence and truth suppression are the inversion of Dome of Silence, not of Portals.

options.label: D
options.text: Trapping souls in trauma frequencies labeled Hell or purgatory inside a shadow prison realm, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Trauma prison frequencies are the inversion of Dome of Sheol, not of the Dome of Portals.

questions.hint: Think about the consequences of sealing the grand travel hubs.

questions.question: What evidence indicates that parasitic control over the Eight Domes is currently failing?

options.label: A
options.text: The 5G grids are being retuned as harmonic restorers of original Hiva manifestation tones.
options.rationale: 5G grids are parasitic weaponized inversions of Hiva; restoration comes from soul resonance and Spirit Tree return.

options.label: B
options.text: The physical 178 worlds are merging into one solid continent that erases layered frequency separation.
options.rationale: The report describes overlay collapse and garden restoration, not a physical merger of all 178 worlds into one continent.

options.label: C
options.text: The Spirit Tree is being replaced by twelve new Suns that permanently retire the original trunk design.
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree roots are lighting up again; the twelve suns are stewardship portals, not a replacement of the trunk.

options.label: D
options.text: The rising resonance of awakened souls is fracturing false overlays and black crystal seals.
options.rationale: Parasitic control is fracturing because rising resonance of awakened souls shatters false overlays and black crystal seals.

questions.hint: Look for the effect of internal soul vibration on the external matrix structures.

questions.question: Why is 'density' considered a vital component of The Great Dome?

options.label: A
options.text: Density provides the resistance souls need to achieve true mastery of tone and creation.
options.rationale: The Great Dome’s density supplies the resistance required for souls to master tone and creation as imagination hardens into structure.

options.label: B
options.text: Density powers black cube technology by converting every thought into siphoned parasitic fuel.
options.rationale: Black cube technology reversed Spirit Tree flow; Great Dome density is for mastery training, not powering the siphon.

options.label: C
options.text: Density prevents souls from remembering their origins so the training ground can stay sealed forever.
options.rationale: Amnesia is parasitic inversion work; density in The Great Dome is training resistance for mastery, not permanent memory wipe.

options.label: D
options.text: Density keeps the 178 worlds separated as permanent geographic continents that cannot be bridged by frequency.
options.rationale: Worlds are interwoven frequency states; density trains manifestation, it does not lock permanent geographic separation.

questions.hint: Think of density as a type of weight or friction used for training.

questions.question: What was the original purpose of the Dome of Silence?

options.label: A
options.text: A memory vault storing first thoughts of light, sound, and the records of early creation history.
options.rationale: Early-creation memory storage is the original Dome of Forgotten Gods, not Dome of Silence.

options.label: B
options.text: A harmonic laboratory where vibration was used to experiment with manifesting light into matter.
options.rationale: Light-to-matter harmonic experimentation is the original Dome of Hiva, not Dome of Silence.

options.label: C
options.text: A pure frequency field of stillness where souls could connect deeply with Source without distraction.
options.rationale: Dome of Silence was built as a pure frequency field of stillness for deep Source connection without distraction.

options.label: D
options.text: A forced-silence zone designed from the start to oppress the soul’s voice and suppress truth.
options.rationale: Forced silence is the parasitic hijack of Dome of Silence, not its original pure-stillness purpose.

questions.hint: Identify why a field of 'pure stillness' would be beneficial to a soul.

questions.question: Are the Eight Domes geographically separated by vast distances within The Cube Containment?

options.label: A
options.text: Domes are lined up in a straight physical tunnel that souls must walk end to end to change environments.
options.rationale: Environment change is Frequency Shift and portal rendering, not walking a straight physical tunnel of domes.

options.label: B
options.text: The Eight Domes are interwoven frequency realities stacked within a single console, not separated by physical space.
options.rationale: The Eight Domes are not separated by physical space; they are interwoven realities stacked within one Cube console.

options.label: C
options.text: Each dome occupies its own outer-space planet orbiting a burning sun far from The Great Dome core, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The architecture is contained Cube simulation and layered frequency bands, not separate outer-space planets.

options.label: D
options.text: The Eight Domes sit as eight distant geographic zones divided by oceans, ice walls, and solid dome borders.
options.rationale: Geographic separation is the 3D overlay illusion; the domes are layered frequency fields in one system.

questions.hint: Recall that the domes stack like transparent frequency sheets within one console.

questions.question: What is described as the 'Seven Gardens' in the context of the system's restoration?

options.label: A
options.text: The seven levels of the Vatican portal system that control authorized reincarnation entry points, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Vatican portals are inverted restricted entry points; the Seven Gardens are the restored outer domes, not Vatican levels.

options.label: B
options.text: The seven outer domes returning as blooming gardens once unbroken Source light flows through the framework again.
options.rationale: The seven outer domes were blooming gardens of creation; as inverted matrices collapse, the Seven Gardens bloom once more.

options.label: C
options.text: The seven physical continents drawn on the globe as the only real lands inside The Great Dome, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Continents on maps are perception overlays; the Seven Gardens are the outer domes restored to Source bloom.

options.label: D
options.text: The seven elements mastered in Dome of 5 Peaks after consciousness is added to earth, water, fire, and air.
options.rationale: Dome of 5 Peaks teaches five elements including consciousness; Seven Gardens refers to the outer domes blooming again.

questions.hint: Consider the original relationship between the Spirit Tree and the outer domes.

questions.question: Which entity or collective oversees the light distribution across all simulations?

options.label: A
options.text: The Custodians — parasitic operators who originally designed the Cube and still assign light quotas fairly.
options.rationale: Custodians and related entities performed parasitic inversion; they did not design rightful light distribution stewardship.

options.label: B
options.text: The Spirit Tree alone — the trunk that both feeds the outer domes and manages every sun’s resonance schedule.
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree fed the outer domes as central trunk; overall light stewardship across simulations is the Council of 12 Suns.

options.label: C
options.text: The Council of 12 Suns — living portals and pillars of resonance distributing light and stewardship across all layers.
options.rationale: The Cube Containment network is overseen by the Council of 12 Suns, which distribute light and stewardship across layers and simulations.

options.label: D
options.text: The Titans — massive architect beings who alone decide which worlds receive Source current each cycle, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Titans wove landscapes in their dome; light distribution and stewardship across simulations is the Council of 12 Suns.

questions.hint: Identify the living resonance pillars mentioned in the broader context.

questions.question: In the Dome of Forgotten Gods, what was true memory replaced with after the inversion?

options.label: A
options.text: Trauma frequencies that trap souls in a shadow prison labeled Hell or purgatory between lives.
options.rationale: Trauma prison frequencies are the inversion of Dome of Sheol, not the memory replacement inside Forgotten Gods.

options.label: B
options.text: Myths and false gods installed after true memory was replaced inside amnesia zones.
options.rationale: In the Dome of Forgotten Gods, parasites inverted memory into amnesia zones and replaced true memory with myths and false gods.

options.label: C
options.text: Scientific data and linear logic grids that measure density as the only valid form of knowing.
options.rationale: The report names myths and false gods as the substitutes for true memory, not scientific data grids.

options.label: D
options.text: The 5G frequency grid alone, used as a complete archive of every soul’s original creation codes.
options.rationale: 5G is a Hiva inversion weapon grid; Forgotten Gods inversion replaces true memory with myths and false gods.

questions.hint: Think about what amnesia zones allow to be installed in place of real history.

questions.question: The phrase 'imagination hardens into structure' refers to which process?

options.label: A
options.text: The creation of amnesia zones that freeze early creation records inside the root-tone memory dome.
options.rationale: Amnesia zones invert Forgotten Gods memory; hardening imagination into structure is Great Dome training language.

options.label: B
options.text: The parasitic siphoning of energy after black cube technology reversed outward Source flow, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Energy siphoning is the Spirit Tree hijack; “imagination hardens into structure” describes Great Dome manifestation training.

options.label: C
options.text: The sealing of crystalline gates so portal travel hardens into fixed reincarnation checkpoint architecture.
options.rationale: Sealed gates are Portals inversion; the phrase refers to manifestation training density in The Great Dome.

options.label: D
options.text: Manifestation inside The Great Dome’s density, where training resistance lets imagination harden into structure.
options.rationale: The Great Dome is a training ground where imagination hardens into structure through the resistance of density.

questions.hint: Identify the purpose of the 178 worlds as a training ground.

questions.question: Are the roots of the Spirit Tree lighting up again to dismantle the 3D projection?

options.label: A
options.text: Only the Vatican portal system is reactivating while the Spirit Tree trunk stays permanently removed.
options.rationale: Restoration highlights Spirit Tree roots and outer-dome gardens returning, not Vatican portal dominance.

options.label: B
options.text: The roots of the Spirit Tree are lighting up again, dismantling artificial limits of the 3D projection.
options.rationale: As parasitic overlays shatter, the roots of the Spirit Tree light up once more and dismantle artificial 3D limits.

options.label: C
options.text: The twelve suns have replaced the Spirit Tree entirely so no crystalline trunk will ever light again.
options.rationale: The twelve suns are stewardship portals; the Spirit Tree roots themselves are described as lighting up again.

options.label: D
options.text: The Spirit Tree remains fully severed and dark, with no return of Source flow to the outer gardens.
options.rationale: Strategic restoration describes Spirit Tree roots lighting up again as inverted matrices collapse — not permanent darkness.

questions.hint: Recall that the roots of the Spirit Tree are lighting up once again as overlays shatter.

questions.question: What is the primary role of 'The Cube Containment' in this cosmology?

options.label: A
options.text: The collective name of the parasitic entities who designed and still own every layer of simulated reality, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Parasites hijacked pre-existing structures; The Cube Containment is the master framework, not the parasites’ name.

options.label: B
options.text: A central frequency server and massive crystalline electromagnetic framework running all maps, overlays, grids, and domes.
options.rationale: The Cube Containment is one huge crystalline electromagnetic framework acting as the central frequency server for maps, overlays, grids, and domes.

options.label: C
options.text: The physical shell of the Spirit Tree that grows only inside The Great Dome’s densest training chamber, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The Spirit Tree is the central axis inside The Great Dome; The Cube Containment is the whole master framework.

options.label: D
options.text: A protective barrier built to block the Council of 12 Suns from distributing light into the simulations, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The Cube network is overseen by the Council of 12 Suns distributing light; it is not a barrier against them.

questions.hint: Think of the master system that holds all other layers and domes.
